DCT employees sign in with their @dctabudhabi.ae e-mail. For other programmes you receive an e-mail invitation with a link to activate your account.
I’m new at DCT. Where do I start?
Register on the employee registration page, verify your e-mail, then start with the two mandatory courses: DCT World and DCTLEARN.
Do I need a separate account for each programme?
No. One account reaches every programme you belong to — you choose between them after signing in.
I didn’t get an invitation. What should I do?
Contact your programme coordinator, or write to learn@dctabudhabi.ae with the programme name.
How do I get my certificate?
Your certificate is issued automatically when you finish every unit in a course and pass its quiz. You’ll find it on your Certificates page.
Is the platform available in Arabic?
Yes. Every page and course is available in Arabic and English, and you can switch at any time.
Can I learn on my phone?
Yes. DCT Learn works on mobile and desktop, and your progress saves automatically so you can continue on any device.
Your next course is one sign-in away
Pick up where you left off on any device, in Arabic or English.

أنا موظف جديد في الدائرة. من أين أبدأ؟
سجّل من صفحة تسجيل الموظفين، وأكّد بريدك، ثم ابدأ بالدورتين الإلزاميتين «عالم الدائرة» و«منصة DCT Learn».
هل أحتاج إلى حساب منفصل لكل برنامج؟
لا. حساب واحد يوصلك إلى كل البرامج التي تنتمي إليها، وتختار بينها بعد تسجيل الدخول.
تواصل مع منسّق البرنامج أو راسلنا على learn@dctabudhabi.ae مع اسم البرنامج.
